releaseNotes:
• Major Update v1.4: Push Notifications & Nearby Network Revolution
• High-reliability FCM background notifications for invites, turns, and game events
• Enhanced Nearby Network with resilient UDP/TCP socket binding, genuine RTT ping, and cross-subnet hotspot discovery
• Fixed winner announcement edge cases, player ID normalization, and reconnection playback
• Visual contrast overhaul: amber-gold AMOLED recent picks, gold-bordered completed lines, and enhanced button accessibility
